description:
Freego X2 Pro All-Terrain Dirt eBike

The Freego X2 Pro is built for riders who want motorcycle-inspired power, pedal-equipped versatility, and a stable off-road ride in one all-terrain electric dirt bike. With a 3000W nominal / 6000W peak rear brushless DC hub motor, a 60V 30Ah / 60V 40Ah lithium-ion battery, and dual riding modes, it is designed for trail riding, open-road exploration, and demanding adventure use.

Core Performance Highlights

Motor: 3000W nominal / 6000W peak rear brushless hub motor.

Top speed: City Mode up to 28 MPH; Off-road Mode up to 50 MPH.

Battery: 60V 30Ah (1800Wh) / 60V 40Ah (2400Wh) Li-ion battery.

Riding range: 37–56 Mi (30Ah) / 49–75 Mi (40Ah), depending on rider weight, terrain, speed, and riding mode.

Max torque: 200 N.m for strong off-road acceleration and climbing support.

Controller: Fardriver brushless motor controller, 100A / 300A.

Why Riders Choose This Model

This model gives riders the feel of an electric dirt bike with pedals while keeping the controls practical and easy to read. Its LCD display shows key ride data, while the full-twist throttle and single-speed drivetrain keep operation simple. City Mode limits speed and output for more controlled riding, while Off-road Mode unlocks the full 50 MPH performance for private roads, trails, and off-road environments where permitted.

Built for Control, Braking, and Rough Terrain

A high carbon steel frame, front and rear hydraulic shock absorbers, an inverted front fork, and a rear KKE shock help the bike stay composed on uneven ground. Hydraulic disc brakes on the front and rear wheels use 4-piston calipers with 203 mm disc rotors for confident stopping power. The spoke wheel setup uses front and rear 19 x 1.6 alloy rims with 70/100-19 tubed, pneumatic motorcycle-grade tires that are built for puncture resistance and off-road grip.

Key Specifications

Model Freego X2 Pro

Motor Power 3000W nominal / 6000W peak rear brushless hub motor (DC)

Top Speed City Mode: 28 MPH (45 km/h); Off-road Mode: 50 MPH (80 km/h)

Battery 60V 30Ah (1800Wh) / 60V 40Ah (2400Wh) Li-ion battery

Range 37–56 Mi (30Ah) / 49–75 Mi (40Ah)

Max Torque 200 N.m

Throttle Full-twist throttle

Frame High carbon steel

Display LCD display

Max Load 264 lb (120 kg)

Net Weight 123 lb (56 kg)

Charging Time 4-6 hours

Brake System Front and rear hydraulic disc brakes, 4-piston calipers, 203 mm rotors

Suspension Hydraulic front and rear shock absorbers, inverted front fork, rear KKE shock

Wheel Type & Size Spoke wheels, front/rear 19 x 1.6 alloy rims

Tire Type & Size 70/100-19 (2.75 x 19 inches) tubed, pneumatic motorcycle-grade tires

Charger 67.2V, 5A

Suggested Rider Height 5'4"-6'5"

What's in the Box

Electric bike frame

60V 30Ah /60V 40Ah battery

67.2V charger

Front and rear lights

19 x 2.75 inch tire setup

Bicycle seat, pedals, keys, and owner's manual

FAQ

Is this electric dirt bike suitable for off-road riding?
Yes. It is built with full suspension, hydraulic disc brakes, motorcycle-grade tires, and Off-road Mode for high-power riding where legally permitted.

How fast can the X2 Pro go?
The X2 Pro reaches up to 28 MPH in City Mode and up to 50 MPH in Off-road Mode.

How far can the Freego X2 Pro ride on one charge?
The listed range is 37–56 Mi (30Ah) / 49–75 Mi (40Ah). Actual range depends on terrain, rider weight, speed, temperature, tire pressure, and riding mode.
